newsitem.title: USA: Full House amends GTECH venture.
newsitem.headline: Full House amends GTECH venture.

text.p: Full House Resorts Inc said Friday it has amended a joint venture pact with GTECH Holdings Corp which will now allow each company to pursue projects independently.

Full House said that a provision has been exercised in a 1995 joint venture agreement with GTECH. Effective March 28, each company will no longer be required to present newly identified business opportunities to the other.
This allows the companies greater flexibility to develop new opportunities independently of each other should they wish to do so, Full House said in a statement.
This change will not affect the existing joint venture projects and does not prevent the companies from jointly pursuing opportunities in the future, it said.

Full House and GTECH had agreed to form a joint venture to share in the financing and development of Native American and casino gaming ventures. The companies have launched The Mill, a gaming facility jointly developed with the Coquille Indian Tribe in Coos Bay, Ore., and Midway Slots and Simulcast, a gaming and entertainment center at Delaware's Harrington Raceway.
